name: Speaker Programs
one_liner: HCP speaker contracting, fair-market-value checks, event logistics and spend transparency.
fits_when: brand teams engage HCPs as paid speakers at meetings or webinars
compliance must check fair market value and annual caps before an HCP is contracted
speaker contracts go out for e-signature and must be signed before an event is approved
events, attendees and every rupee spent on them must be logged with evidence
transfers of value have to be reported per HCP for disclosure or UCPMP / EFPIA rules
gives_you: Speaker nomination with duplicate checks and an FMV review by compliance
Rate and annual cap set at approval, with a near-cap flag on every speaker
Contracts sent for e-signature and signed by the speaker in their own login
Event lifecycle from planning through approval, completion and spend reconciliation
Attendee log and spend lines per event, verified against invoices
Speaker 360 page with contracts, events, spend and an activity timeline

catalogue.description: A speaker program app for HCP engagements: brand managers nominate speakers, compliance sets fair market value and caps, contracts go out for e-signature, event ops runs events and logs attendees and spend, and every transfer of value is reported per HCP. The spec is previewed live as a clickable app with demo data while the requirement is shaped.

roles.name: Brand manager
roles.description: Nominates speakers and plans events within the brand budget

roles.name: Event ops
roles.description: Runs event logistics, logs attendees and records spend lines

roles.name: Compliance reviewer
roles.description: Checks FMV and caps, approves speakers and events, sends contracts and reconciles spend

roles.name: Speaker
roles.description: External HCP login that signs contracts and sees only their own events and payments

workflows.name: Speaker nomination
workflows.description: Nominate, submit for review, approve or reject, with duplicate checks

workflows.name: FMV check & contract
workflows.description: Rate and cap from the FMV method, contract sent for e-signature and signed by the speaker

workflows.name: Event logistics
workflows.description: Plan, approve against a signed contract, run, log attendees and complete

workflows.name: Spend reporting
workflows.description: Spend lines verified against invoices, reconciled per event and reported per HCP

compliance: FMV rate and annual cap approved before an HCP is contracted
No event approved without a signed contract with events remaining
Spend transparency: every transfer of value tied to a recipient HCP and an invoice
UCPMP / EFPIA disclosure reporting per HCP
Audit trail of every approval, signature and spend change
